content.title: What channel is Yankees vs Athletics today? How to watch, prediction
content.text: Updated April 7, 2026, 3:23 p.m. ETAfter an off day, the New York Yankees are back in action.The Yankees (7-2, 1st in AL East) own the best record in the American League as they've won each of their first three series, including most recently taking two of three versus the Miami Marlins in their first series at home this season.The Yankees continue their homestand as begin a three-game set in the Bronx versus the Athletics (3-6, 4th in AL West).Here's important details you need to know on how to watch, stream and our prediction on who will Yankees vs Athletics series opener on Tuesday night:When is Yankees vs Athletics game today?Date: Tuesday, April 7What time is Yankees vs Athletics game today?Time: 7:05 p.m. ETHow to watch Yankees vs Athletics game todayTV channel: YES NetworkStream: Gotham SportsWatch Yankees regular-season games live on FuboTVYankees, Athletics starting pitchers todayYankees: Cam Schlittler (2-0, 0.00 ERA)Athletics: Aaron Civale (1-0, 3.60 ERA)Yankees' Cam Schlittler has dominated through his first two starts of the 2026 season.Schlittler scoreless streak is at 11 2/3 innings, as he blanked both the Mariners and Giants and currently sports an outlandish 15:0 strikeout-to-walk ratio.Athletics' Aaron Civale went five innings and allowed two runs on four hits in his lone outing where he picked up the win in a 5-2 victory over the Atlanta Braves on March 31.Yankees vs Athletics game oddsOdds according to BetMGM as of Tuesday, April 7:Spread: Yankees by 1.5Over/under: 8.5Moneyline: Yankees (-295), Athletics (+190)Prediction for Yankees vs Athletics todayCam Schlittler continues his early season success, as the 25-year-old flamethrower pitches into the seventh inning and racks up nine strikeouts, with the Yankees offense doing enough to get Schlittler the win and continuing their hot start early in the season.Prediction: Yankees 5, Athletics 2Our editors independently choose our recommendations.
